Odia spelling dictionary from AI4Bharat Aksharantar
Data designation for this extract: CC0 1.0 (mined Wikidata, Samanantar, and IndicCorp pairs)
CC0: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Research publication: https://aclanthology.org/2023.findings-emnlp.4/
Source and licensing: https://indicnlp.ai4bharat.org/aksharantar/
Archive revision: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ai4bharat/Aksharantar/blob/b311c19b4a66bfac52ca4d95456b4b5646aca49e/ori.zip

This derivative indexes individual transliteration pairs by normalized Roman spelling.
It filters out non-word pairs, lower-scoring IndicCorp pairs, other source categories,
and the test split. It ranks by source and score and keeps up to three pairs per key.
The upstream subset contains words and named entities. These pairs are spelling
suggestions. They do not verify an ownership record.
